cosplay.name: Indian Championship of Cosplay (ICC)
cosplay.summary: Comic Con India's national cosplay contest: city qualifiers (₹50,000 and a finals spot for each winner) lead to a national finale. The 2026 Grand Champion, Arindam Paul, won ₹4 lakh. The 2027 contest hasn't been announced yet.
